summary: Q32 Bio Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 6,027,399 firm shares at $18.25/share and 4,931,506 pre-funded warrants at $18.2499 each, with a 30-day underwriter option for up to 1,643,835 additional shares. Net proceeds estimated at ~$187.6M (or ~$215.8M if option exercised) will fund working capital, R&D, and clinical trials for bempikibart. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No extraordinary corporate event is triggered. Closing expected July 16, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
